kapak.alt: KVKK Law No. 6698 and clinical placement

youtube.baslik: Why is photographing an audiogram with your phone wrong? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In Türkiye, the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698, known as KVKK, treats health data as a special category of personal data; so an audiogram or report is information to be carefully protected. No photos of the patient file, screen or audiogram are taken with a personal phone or shared on social media; patients' names and findings are not discussed in hallways, and the screen is locked when you leave the computer. In case presentations, identifying details are removed, in other words the data are de-identified.
